scores.notes: Compared Moses on the shore (left foreground) with the staff-bearing elder at the front of the line (right centre): both have swept-back white hair, a full white beard, an elderly face and a lean build.
Compared Jesus by the fire (left centre) with Jesus standing in the stern (right): both have long, centre-parted dark-brown hair, a short dark beard, the same narrow face and olive skin.

Both show a wooden fishing boat with a mast on a choppy grey-green lake, with hills and a village of flat-roofed stone houses on the left shore. The left is moonlit and the right is a stormy dusk, which fits a single evening rather than night against full day.

The left den is a shallow, open well-ring of tan stone in a sunlit palm courtyard, with lions just below the rim. The right is a deep, wide domed chamber of grey stone that opens only through a small oculus high overhead, so the architecture conflicts despite the round wooden lid and barred grate in both.

Both show walls of water over a rocky seabed with mountains beyond, but the left is night, with a dark navy sky lit only by the distant pillar of fire. The right has a pale daylight sky with a bright horizon and evenly lit green water walls, so night conflicts with day.

Both show water walls and a rocky seabed, but the left (chariots) is lit by a pale daytime sky with a bright horizon. The right (Moses) is under a black night storm sky lit only by the fiery cloud, so day conflicts with night.
Both show a rough stone farmhouse among olive trees and a dusty yard and road, with terraced fields, a hillside village and a lake below the hills in the distance, all in warm daylight.
Both are night scenes of a seabed between towering dark-teal water walls, with rocky ground, distant low mountains and fiery light in the sky or at the far end; the arrangement is compatible.
Both show a moonlit night storm, with a wooden mast boat in grey-green swells under dark cloud and a hilly shoreline (the left also has a stone village), so the place and time are consistent.

Both are rainy, moonlit night storms with the same open wooden boat, mast and rigging in dark swells; the left shows hills on the shore and the right a stone village, which fits a different viewpoint.
Both show a pebbly lakeshore at hazy dawn, with a wooden boat at the water's edge, a charcoal fire, and a hillside village with palms and cypresses on the right above calm water.

Both versions of Daniel have grey hair and a white beard, but the left Daniel (on the rim) has light olive skin and a fuller, ruddy face. The right Daniel (standing in the den) has distinctly dark-brown skin on his face and hands and a gaunter face, while the lions and walls around him are evenly lit.

Both show a wooden mast boat with a ragged sail being swamped in green-grey storm waves at stormy dusk, with a glow on the horizon and a hilly shoreline with a village; the right also has a lantern and companion boats.
Both are moonlit night storms on the lake, with a wooden mast boat and oars and a stone village on the left shore under heavy cloud.
Both are dark storm scenes with a wooden mast boat lit by a small lantern and a hilly shore with a village; the left is a stormy twilight and the right is moonlit, which fits the same evening.
Both show a pebbly lakeshore in hazy morning light, with a wooden boat at the shore, a coal fire on the sand, and a green hillside village with palms and cypresses on the right.

The left description (disciples stepping onto the sand) does not single out Simon Peter, though the net-carrying man in front resembles the leaping Peter on the right (curly greying hair, grey beard). The rules give no basis for picking him.

Both show a circular pit of grey dressed-stone blocks with an iron barred grate at the top, lions on a sandy floor, and Darius at the upper rim; the left is open to the daytime sky and the right adds torches.
Both show a dusty road winding between dry-stone walls through olive groves, with terraced hills and cypresses in daylight; the right adds a stone house at the side.
Both are night scenes of the seabed between tall dark-green water walls, with rocks along the edges under a cloudy night sky; the left also shows a moon and a clifftop town.

The left Daniel (standing in the den) has short-cropped dark-grey hair and a full white beard. The right Daniel (being lifted out) has collar-length silver hair swept back and only a short trimmed grey beard, with a lighter, different face.

Both are night scenes at the parting sea, with dark storm or moonlit sky and teal-green walls of water over a sandy, rocky floor; the right shows the shore and the left the corridor, which fits a different viewpoint.
Both are moonlit night scenes with teal-green waves or walls of water over a sandy seabed, and a town on cliffs on the right horizon in each.
